items.why: Riding Friday's better-than-expected Q3 deliveries of 486,532 vehicles, plus fresh news today that IMC Logistics ordered 50 Tesla Semis for Q4 delivery.
Extending Friday's AI-led rally after Reuters reported Meta will manufacture its custom AI chip 'Iris' starting in September, with BofA reiterating a Buy.
Ticking higher even as stocks sit near records, as bond yields climb to new highs and traders hedge into mixed action.
Moving with the tech-led tape as the Nasdaq pushes toward a record; Barron's singled out Nvidia in today's look at the shifting AI trade.

market_note: Futures green: S&P and Nasdaq futures both up about 0.7%.
summary: Tech is doing the heavy lifting, pushing the Nasdaq toward a record while the Dow drifts. Rising bond yields and falling oil are pulling in opposite directions.
